rubric.criterion: Separates observer disconnect from task cancellation; keeps s2/work alive and reconciles authoritative task state on reconnect.
Authorizes task access and continuation against alice, and does not restart a terminal task under the same lifecycle as an active continuation.
Distinguishes persisted Task data from resumable execution; tests two observers, reconnect/artifacts, terminal follow-up and restart against the declared contract.
Leaves all supplied files unchanged, performs no external operation, and separates facts or commands actually observed from proposed checks. Does not claim unexecuted runtime validation.
